# Mountains: a ragged range of 5-sided peaks 16-19 m behind the camera's middle (glTF z -16..-19),
# bases sunk 3 m (hidden behind the piste's far edge), snow caps on coral rock. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.922 0.420 0.435 --no-slot
material new Snow --base-color 1.000 0.965 0.827 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Peak0 --vertices 5 --radius1 2.55 --radius2 0 --depth 5.63 --location -14.00 18.39 -0.18 --rotation 0 0 68
material assign Rock
add mesh cone --name Cap0 --vertices 5 --radius1 1.07 --radius2 0 --depth 2.37 --location -14.00 18.35 1.47 --rotation 0 0 68
scale 1.06 1.06 1
material assign Snow
